title: connectors 0.5.8: read one To Do / Planner item status by exact id (T104b)
head: t104b-item-status
body:
T104b step 1 of 2 (connectors). Read one linked To Do or Planner item's status by its exact id, so the Tasks page can move a linked step. No writes, no new scopes, no new ask-first gate.

## What
- `todo_item_status(list_id, task_id)` → `GET /me/todo/lists/{id}/tasks/{id}?$select=id,status` (Tasks.Read). completed → done, inProgress → in_progress, notStarted/waitingOnOthers/deferred → left.
- `planner_item_status(task_id)` → `GET /planner/tasks/{id}?$select=id,percentComplete`. 100 → done, 1–99 → in_progress, 0 → left.
- Returns only `{item_id, status}`; the title and body are never returned, so injected title text cannot reach a caller. Bad status values, bool/float/out-of-range percent, and unsafe ids (`/ ? # ..`, whitespace, control chars) are refused before any HTTP call. 404 → fixed "not found". One audit line per call (existing `read_todo` / `read_planner`).
- docs/graph-read.md "T104b additions"; 0.5.8.
